checkin.title: Check in / out
checkin.subtitle: Punch from this device. The time is always the server's clock; your location is checked against the work zones assigned to you.
checkin.hoursDone: Your hours for today are done — you can check out.
checkin.noFences: no work zone is assigned to you

geo.denied: Location access is blocked. Allow location for this site in your browser settings, then refresh.
geo.unavailable: Your location could not be determined. Move to an open area or turn on location services.
geo.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again.
geo.unsupported: This browser cannot share your location.

no_fence.title: No work zone applies
no_fence.body: Your punch is recorded without a location check.

allowed.title: Inside {{zone}}
allowed.body: You are inside your work zone. You can punch.

flagged.title: Outside {{zone}}
flagged.body: You are {{distance}} from the zone. Your punch is recorded and flagged for your manager to review.

logged.title: Outside {{zone}}
logged.body: You are {{distance}} from the zone. Your punch is recorded and your location is logged.

denied_outside.title: Outside {{zone}}
denied_outside.body: You are {{distance}} from the zone. Move inside the work zone to punch.

denied_mock.title: Simulated location detected
denied_mock.body: Your device reports a mock location. Turn off location spoofing or developer mock locations, then try again.

verdict.lowAccuracy: Your location is too imprecise to confirm you are inside {{zone}}. Move near a window or turn on precise location, then refresh.
verdict.locationMissing: Share your location to punch here: {{zone}} is checked for every punch.

checkin.mockNote: Location spoofing apps and mock locations are detected and recorded.
checkin.outOfWindow: It is outside the punch window ({{start}}–{{end}}).
checkin.blockedTitle: You can't punch from here right now

refusal.WEB_CHECKIN_DISABLED: Web check-in is turned off for your organisation.
refusal.MOBILE_CHECKIN_DISABLED: Mobile check-in is turned off for your organisation.
refusal.IP_NOT_ALLOWED: Punches are only accepted from your organisation's network.
refusal.OUT_OF_WINDOW: Punching is not allowed at this time of day.
refusal.OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE: You are outside your work zone.
refusal.DUPLICATE_PUNCH: You punched moments ago; this one was not recorded twice.
refusal.ALREADY_CHECKED_IN: You are already checked in. Check out first.
refusal.NOT_CHECKED_IN: You are not checked in. Check in first.
refusal.PERIOD_LOCKED: This attendance period is locked for payroll.
refusal.NOT_ACTIVE: Your employee record is not active.
refusal.CHECKIN_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Your attendance policy does not allow this way of checking in.

checkin.flaggedHint: Recorded and flagged for your manager to review.

selfie.hint: Take a clear photo of your face. It counts as a punch — at the time you send it — once your manager approves it.
selfie.sent: Selfie sent for review. It counts once your manager approves it.
selfie.noCamera: The camera is not available here. Choose a photo instead.
selfie.noLocation: Your location is not included; your manager sees that too.
selfie.tooLarge: The photo is larger than 2 MB.
selfie.badType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
selfie.required: Your manager asks for a selfie with every punch: use the selfie check-in.

offline.title: Saved on this device ({{count}})
offline.hint: These punches are sent automatically when the connection is back. The server records its own time and keeps the time you punched as a note.
offline.queued: No connection. Your punch is saved on this device and will be sent automatically.
offline.legacyDiscarded_one: {{count}} punch saved on this device by an earlier version was removed: it could not be tied to an account. If it was yours, punch again or request a regularisation.
offline.legacyDiscarded_other: {{count}} punches saved on this device by an earlier version were removed: they could not be tied to an account. If they were yours, punch again or request a regularisation.

checkin.footer: Forgot to punch, or a punch is wrong?
checkin.accuracyWarning: Your location is only accurate to ±{{meters}} m (more than {{limit}} m). Move to an open area or wait a moment and refresh — the zone check may not be able to place you.

calendar.hasReason: A reason was given for this day

notes.title: Explain a day
notes.hint: Tell your manager why the day looks the way it does. It is reviewed like a request; nothing changes until it is.
notes.noteHint: A few words your manager can act on.
notes.resubmitted: Answer sent. Your manager reviews the reason again.
notes.question: Your manager asked: {{question}}
notes.emptyHint: Add a reason to a day from My attendance, or here.

regularisation.title: Request a regularisation
regularisation.hint: For a missed or wrong punch, a work-from-home day that was not marked, or a terminal that was down. Nothing changes until it is approved.

types.wrong_punch: A punch has the wrong time

regularisation.timesRequired: Give the check-in and / or check-out time.
regularisation.presentHint: Once approved the day counts as present; any times you give are added as punches.
regularisation.reasonHint: At least 3 characters, e.g. "Terminal was offline at the gate".
regularisation.submitted: Regularisation requested. Your approvers have been notified.
regularisation.withdrawHint: Your approvers will no longer see it. You can send a new one later.
regularisation.emptyHint: Missed a punch or worked from home? Request a regularisation.

requests.title: My requests
requests.subtitle: Reasons, regularisations, shift swaps and selfie check-ins you sent, and the decisions on them.

selfies.emptyHint: Selfie check-ins you send from the check-in page appear here with their review.
selfies.photoUnavailable: The photo could not be loaded.
selfies.photoHint: The link works for one minute and opening it is recorded.

shift.title: My shift
shift.subtitle: Your working pattern for the coming days, where it comes from, and your shift swaps.
shift.noUpcoming: No schedule for the coming days.

swap.title: Request a shift swap
swap.hint: Pick a day and a colleague: you work their shift and they work yours. Your manager decides; the swap applies to that day only.
swap.noDays: No working day to swap in the coming days
swap.noCandidates: No colleague works a different shift that day.
swap.submitted: Swap requested. Your manager has been notified.
swap.withdrawHint: Your manager and your colleague will no longer see it as pending.
swap.emptyHint: Need to trade a day? Request a swap from My shift.

hints.title: Where to improve
hints.low_attendance: Your attendance ({{value}}%) is below the {{target}}% target.
hints.short_hours: You average {{value}} h a day, under the {{target}} h full day.
hints.missing_checkouts_one: You forgot to check out on {{value}} day.
hints.missing_checkouts_other: You forgot to check out on {{value}} days.

timeAway.title: Time away

kindHints.OFFICIAL: A client visit, a ministry or a bank on company business. Counts as worked time.
kindHints.OFFICIAL_UNPAID: A client visit, a ministry or a bank on company business. Excused, but not counted as worked time.
kindHints.PERSONAL: A personal errand. Excused once approved, but unpaid.

timeAway.stepOutHint: Records that you leave the site now and asks your manager to approve the time away. When you are back, check in on the terminal.
timeAway.stepOutHintPortal: Records that you leave the site now and asks your manager to approve the time away. When you are back, check in on the terminal or tap “I'm back”.
timeAway.expectedBackHint: Between 5 minutes and 12 hours from now.
timeAway.expectedBackInvalid: Choose a time between 5 minutes and 12 hours from now.
timeAway.reasonHint: What the time away is for. Your manager reads it.
timeAway.destinationPlaceholder: e.g. Ministry of Labour, Al Khuwair
timeAway.steppedOut: You stepped out at {{time}}. Expected back at {{back}}.
timeAway.backDone: Welcome back. Your return was recorded at {{time}}.
timeAway.backOnDevice: Check in on the terminal when you are back.
timeAway.checkInFirst: Check in first: you can step out while you are on site.
timeAway.stepOutDisabled: Your attendance policy does not allow stepping out from the portal. Ask your manager to record the time away.
timeAway.measuredHint: As classified when your day was last calculated.

inactive.DISABLED: Time away is not measured under your attendance policy.
inactive.FIRST_LAST_INTERPRETATION: Your attendance policy keeps only your first and last punch of the day, so time away cannot be measured. Ask HR to switch the policy to paired or directional punches.

errors.TIME_AWAY_DISABLED: Time away is not enabled in your attendance policy.
errors.TIME_AWAY_NOT_MEASURABLE: Your attendance policy keeps only your first and last punch, so time away cannot be measured. Ask HR to switch to paired or directional punches.
errors.STEP_OUT_DISABLED: Your attendance policy does not allow stepping out from the portal. Ask your manager to record the time away.
errors.ALREADY_AWAY: You have already stepped out. Check in when you are back.
errors.NOT_ON_SITE: Check in first: you can only step out while you are on site.
errors.RETURN_ON_DEVICE: Check in on the terminal when you are back: your attendance policy records the return on site only.
errors.TIME_AWAY_QUOTA: Not enough personal permission left this month: {{used}} of {{quota}} is already used or waiting.
errors.TIME_AWAY_TOO_LONG: Personal permission is at most {{max}} at a time.
errors.TIME_AWAY_TOO_OLD: Time away can be requested at most 7 days back.

timeAway.requestHint: Plan a window of your working day. Your manager is asked to approve it, and the time away is measured from your punches.
timeAway.windowTooLong: A window is at most 16 hours.
timeAway.personalTooLong: Personal permission is at most {{max}} at a time.
timeAway.quotaExceeded: Only {{left}} of personal permission left this month.
timeAway.withdrawHint: The approvers are told. The time away is measured as usual from your punches.
timeAway.emptyHint: Plan official duty or a personal permission ahead, or step out from the check-in page.
